parameters.query: =SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*)::int, 0) as total FROM reservations WHERE event_date = '{{ $json.fecha }}' AND time_slot = '{{ $json.timeSlot }}' AND status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'confirmed')

=INSERT INTO reservations (user_id, event_type, event_date, time_slot, guests, total_price, deposit_amount, notes, status, created_at) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = '{{ $json.email }}' LIMIT 1), '{{ $json.tipoEvento }}', '{{ $json.fecha }}', '{{ $json.timeSlot }}', {{ $json.pax }}, {{ $json.precioTotal }}, {{ $json.depositoAmount }}, '{{ $json.mensaje }}', 'pending', NOW()) RETURNING id
